actual: Changing backend/services/hmm_risk/stock_fact_repository.py only affects the offline HMM source-preparation path: current call graph has no FastAPI/backend runtime importer, while scripts/hmm_risk prepare and holdout tools are already exact non-runtime authorities. Runtime classification currently falls through backend/**/*.py, invents backend-main restart/runbook/fresh-process blockers, and prevents BUG-1140 finish. Add only the exact offline source path and direct classifier regression test; preserve fail-closed classification for every neighboring HMM backend file and for real backend sources.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
